summary: When any compared hotel has a fee-inclusive nightly total, do not rank fallback-only hotels in the same LowestTotal sort; only rank fallback hotels against each other when every hotel is fallback-only.
reason: RatePlanRate has no fee fields. A room-only average*nights hotel would otherwise sort ahead of a cheaper fee-inclusive hotel.
validated_outcome: internal/cli tests cover mixed inclusive-vs-fallback inter-hotel ranking and fallback-only apples-to-apples ranking.
